content: जातिः {%f.%} [जन्-क्तिन्] .²1 Birth, production, सङ्कुलं जलजातिभिः <ls>Rām. 3. 11. 6</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 38</ls>; <ls>Ms. 2. 148</ls>; also ‘the time of birth’; <ab>cf.</ab> जातौ बाल्ये च कौमारे यौवने चापि मानवाः <ls>Mb. 12. 158. 11</ls>. .²2 The form of existence fixed by birth. .²3 Race, family, lineage, rank. .²4 A caste, tribe or class (of men); अरे मूढ जात्या चेदवध्योऽहम् एषा सा जातिः परित्यक्ता <ls>Ve. 3</ls>; (the primary castes of the Hindus are only four:-- ब्राह्मण, क्षत्रिय, वैश्य and शूद्र). .²5 A class, genus, kind, species; पशुजातिः, पुष्पजातिः <ab>&c.</ab> .²6 The properties which are peculiar to a class and distinguish it from all others, the essential characteristics of a species; as गोत्व, अश्वत्व of cows, horses <ab>&c.</ab>; see गुण, क्रिया and द्रव्य; जातिक्रियागुणैः <ls>Śi. 2. 47</ls>; and <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>K. P. 2</ls>. .²7 A fire-place. .²8 Nutmeg. .²9 The Jasmine plant or its flower; नागपुन्नागजातिभिः <ls>Bhāg. 8. 2. 18</ls>; पुष्पाणां प्रकरः स्मितेन रचितो नो कुन्दजात्यादिभिः <ls>Amaru. 40</ls> (written also as जाती in the last two senses). .²10 (In Nyāya) Futile answer. .²11 (In music) The seven primary notes of the Indian gamut; जातिभिः सप्तभिर्युक्तं तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम् <ls>Rām. 1. 4. 8</ls>. .²12 Reduction of fractions to a common denominator. .²13 False generalization. .²14 A figure of speech (in rhetoric) which consists in so arranging words that they may read the same in Sanskṛt as well as in Prākṛta (संस्कृतप्राकृतयोः समा जातिः); <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Vb. 1. 30</ls>. .²15 A class of metres; see <ls>App.</ls>
